svg.title: dsh-scaffold structure: three actor lanes (consumer / library / host · CI) across four phases — setup, call, dispose, CI gate
svg.desc: The package exports four subpaths; setup mounts zero plugin rows in the host, calls use the pure helpers, stop runs the disposer, and the CI gate turns the verify report into one exit code.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, 'SF Mono', 'Liberation Mono', monospace
ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: three actors × four phases — import, call, dispose, verify; the package starts no I/O of its own
